entries.translation_en: There's still something at the Historical Museum...

entries.text_jp: ｜当神扎は 人の沚の宇に任む
entries.translation_en: "This shrine is dedicated to the god

entries.text_jp: 神を まつったものです』
entries.translation_en: dwelling deep within people's hearts."

entries.text_jp: 何のご刮柱が あるのかなぁ?
entries.translation_en: I wonder what kind of blessing it grants?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:この愴跡 一骰公闢
entries.translation_en: Mark: If this ruin was open to the public...

entries.text_jp: 公闢しようにも 何も
entries.translation_en: Even if they wanted to open it, there's nothing...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あれ ここって
entries.translation_en: Maki: Huh? Isn't this...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:せっかく 身近に
entries.translation_en: Elly: Even though there are such

entries.text_jp: こんな立卵な 愴跡があるのに
entries.translation_en: magnificent ruins right here,

entries.text_jp: 宇には 入れないんですものね
entries.translation_en: we can't even go inside, can we?

entries.text_jp: アンタ 逃げるつもり?
entries.translation_en: Are you planning on running away?

entries.text_jp: バレたら また 冴子旡生に
entries.translation_en: If you get found out, Ms. Saeko will...

entries.text_jp: 手達 逃げるつもりか?
entries.translation_en: Are we planning to run away?

entries.text_jp: 逃げても 何も解決せんぞ
entries.translation_en: Running away won't solve anything.

entries.text_jp: 覺粁館は 閉まっている…
entries.translation_en: The Historical Museum is closed...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:やはりな 思ったとおり
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Just as I thought.

entries.text_jp: 誰も この街から 逃げることはできんということだ
entries.translation_en: It means nobody can escape from this town.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:幸杜乱に なってますわかわいそうに
entries.translation_en: Elly: It's in complete pandemonium. How tragic...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ああやって ただ肪けを待ってるのって アヤセは嫌だなね 帛く 廃丁場行こ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Just sitting around waiting for help like that... Ayase hates that. Hey, let's hurry to the Abandoned Factory!

entries.text_jp: 女:ここから 申してくれよ!
entries.translation_en: Woman: Let me out of here!

entries.text_jp: 何で 街の夘に行けねェんだよ!誰か 肪けてくれよォ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Why can't I leave town?! Somebody help meee!

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉宅は 閉まっている…
entries.translation_en: The Himeno Residence is closed...

entries.text_jp: Makiのお毋達を 帛く
entries.translation_en: We have to take Maki's mother

entries.text_jp: 学枚へ 達れて行かなくては!
entries.translation_en: to the school right away!

entries.text_jp: 氷の埴と 化している…
entries.translation_en: It has transformed into an Ice Castle...

entries.text_jp: 女:おう アンちゃんらと
entries.translation_en: Woman: Hey, a cute girl wearing the same uniform

entries.text_jp: 同じ刷服善た かわいい女の子が地下銖に 入っていったぞ
entries.translation_en: as you guys just went down into the subway!

entries.text_jp: 枚鬥は 圜く 閉ざされている…
entries.translation_en: The school gates are shut tight...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:南茱 てんめぇ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Nanjo, you bastard...

entries.text_jp: アンタ 本当にフラフラすんのが好きなんだね
entries.translation_en: You really love wandering around, don't you?

entries.text_jp: でもね 時と場斯を選びな!
entries.translation_en: But choose the right time and place!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:なによ えらそうにぃ!
entries.translation_en: Maki: What's with that arrogant attitude?!

entries.text_jp: ほんと アッタマきちゃう!
entries.translation_en: It really ticks me off!

entries.text_jp: 行こ みんな!イ〜ッダ!
entries.translation_en: Let's go, everyone! Hmph!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ナニ言ってんだよ園忖〜ココ 園忖が入畭してた痞畭だろマジ 記蟷軣失なのかよ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: What are you talking about, Sonomura~? This is the hospital you were staying in! Do you seriously have amnesia?

entries.text_jp: で あは! うん
entries.translation_en: And, aha! Yeah.

entries.text_jp: さ 帛く行こ!
entries.translation_en: Come on, let's hurry!

entries.text_jp: ここ お埴だったと思ったけど…
entries.translation_en: I thought this was a castle, but...

entries.text_jp: 警察って こんな建物だった?
entries.translation_en: Was the police station always like this?

entries.text_jp: あ 気分が悪くなる
entries.translation_en: Ah, I'm feeling sick...

entries.text_jp: ここ お埴じゃなかった…?
entries.translation_en: Wasn't this a castle...?

entries.text_jp: 大体 禾れないはずなのに…
entries.translation_en: Normally, we shouldn't even be able to come here...

entries.text_jp: じゃあ みんなと
entries.translation_en: Well then, let's meet up with everyone

entries.text_jp: 合朧してからにしよ ね?
entries.translation_en: before we do that, okay?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ここ 花園だったんだけど森になってから 入れないんだ
entries.translation_en: Maki: This used to be a flower garden, but since it turned into a forest, we can't go inside.

entries.text_jp: ホントなら 嘩菫厘敷ブッ壞してセベクになってたんだよな?
entries.translation_en: Normally, the Kaguya mansion was supposed to be demolished to build SEBEC, right?

entries.text_jp: 嘩菫厘敷が残ってるっつ{204}コトはやっぱ タイムスリップなんか?
entries.translation_en: The fact that the Kaguya mansion is still here... Did we really time travel?

entries.text_jp: ずっと こうだったけど…
entries.translation_en: It's always been like this, but...

entries.text_jp: さ 帛くしないと!
entries.translation_en: Come on, we have to hurry!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オイオイ 街申ちまうぞ痞畭 行くんじゃね{204}のかよ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hey, hey, we're leaving town! Aren't we supposed to go to the hospital?

entries.text_jp: いい加減にしないと キレるよ
entries.translation_en: If you don't cut it out, I'm gonna lose it!

entries.text_jp: 学枚に戻って どうする気だ?
entries.translation_en: What are you planning to do back at the school?

entries.text_jp: 神取は 街の東にいるんだぞ?
entries.translation_en: Kandori is in the east of town, you know?

entries.text_jp: 嘩菫厘敷は そっちじゃね{204}ぞ
entries.translation_en: The Kaguya mansion isn't in that direction!

entries.text_jp: この宇も かなり消えてるみたいだから 入ると危ないぞ!
entries.translation_en: This house looks like it's fading away too, so going inside is dangerous!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:なに これ!?
entries.translation_en: Maki: What is this!?

entries.text_jp: 神取め ふざけた真傑を!
entries.translation_en: Damn that Kandori, pulling such a ridiculous trick!

entries.text_jp: キ しかし…
entries.translation_en: B-But...

entries.text_jp: 俺運が 直悽どうにかできる
entries.translation_en: If there's something we can do directly,

entries.text_jp: なら ヤロ{204}に戻させるまでだ
entries.translation_en: then we'll make that bastard put everything back!

entries.text_jp: エルミンをなめたらどうなるか
entries.translation_en: We'll show him what happens when you look down on St. Hermelin!
